releases.name: v0.3.0 — OpenCode V2 port + per-model flex toggles
releases.body:
**Ported to the OpenCode V2 plugin API** (V1 plugin builds no longer run in OpenCode 2):

- `{ id, setup(ctx) }` entrypoint behind a root `server.ts` package entry
- Flex injection via session hooks (`context`/`compaction`/`generate`), plus an `http.request` hook that guarantees `service_tier: "flex"` reaches the request body regardless of provider-option lowering
- Telemetry capture via the native `http.response` hook (tee'd SSE parsing of `:energy`/`:cost` comments)
- Per-turn accounting on `session.step.ended`/`failed`; subagent discovery from `session.created` events (works on 2.0.x builds with no session-listing method on the plugin context)

**Per-model flex toggling** (on by default):

- `flex-toggle` tool and `/flex` slash command: `list` / `enable` / `disable` / `reset`, by model ID or glob pattern (`deepseek-*`, `*/glm-5.3`)
- Preferences persist in `~/.config/opencode/.neuralwatt-flex.json`, shared across server processes and re-read when the file changes; `enable` also clears auto-disables so a flex-errored model can recover without a restart
- Stats reports split `User-disabled (persistent)` from `Auto-disabled (this process)`

**Docs**: README caught up with V2 install/config, a current-format sample report, and the toggle reference.

Requires OpenCode V2 (verified end-to-end on 2.0.25). Also published to npm as [`@logical-or/neuralwatt-flex`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@logical-or/neuralwatt-flex).
